csharp_indent_braces #

Indent the braces of a block themselves. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 against the oracle at 2025.2.6: it governs a brace that is on a LINE OF ITS OWN, and the oracle is flat at both values under the export's csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = none. With the braces split (= all) the answer is Whitesmiths — the brace takes one level and the body takes the SAME level: class C / { / void M() / { / if (true). Skala applied it whatever the brace placement, so under none the joined opening brace could not move and the closing one did, producing a shape no configuration of either key writes. SK-DIV-0091.

csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks #

Keep a block that was written on one line on one line. ⚠ Not what the name says, and measured twice. 2026-08-29: two distinct oracle outputs at true against false, Skala flat. 2026-10-08 (#510, SK-DIV-0162), probed with each candidate shape: at false the oracle expands every one-statement accessor body (get { return _n; }), lambda and anonymous-method body (in a statement and as a sole argument alike — Register(delegate { A(); }) moves the delegate to a line of its own, which is the ordinary layout of a broken anonymous-method argument and not a special one) and every bodiless accessor list (int R { get; set; } comes back one accessor per line). It moves nothing else: methods, local functions and control blocks are expanded at both values under the export, and initializers, anonymous types, property patterns and empty blocks stay joined at both. ⚠ With both skala_keep_existing_*_block_arrangement keys true the oracle is byte-identical at both values — the keep keys outrank this one, and Skala reads it only where they are off.
